purpose: Read-only audit of legacy BRACE evidence used as MOTIVATION ONLY for the capability-transport line. Nothing in this file enters the T1+ method chain: difficulty is frozen exclusively from the new 240x8 pi0 baseline measurement (protocol.t1.v1.json).

causal_vs_random_contrast.reading: Within-state Q-variance is statistically real (exact p ~ 5e-5, Tarone z 2.80) but the causal points show SMALLER training-gain proxy than matched random controls. Variance does not identify useful data. This is the direct motivation for switching from value-variance selection to capability-transport tomography over difficulty groups.

e0_v2_variance_gate_fail.status: FAILED per protocol; line permanently stopped; archive read-only, never rerun.

e0_v1_fail.role: earlier FAIL of the same route; motivation only

census_v142_r3.reading: Strongly bimodal p0(x): 36.5% of census seeds at 0/3 and 50% at 3/3. Consistent with the coverage-collapse premise (success-only replay re-weights toward already-supported regions). R=3 is a presketch only; it cannot define frozen soft groups.
census_v142_r3.limitation: R=3 < R=8 required by the new protocol; seed set (100114-100352) partially overlaps the multitask_v1 anchor_candidate partition; NOT used for grouping.

bak_100x8_rough_histogram.reading: On the rollout_train pool (100000-100099) at R=8, p0(x) is again bimodal: 52% always-success, 16% zero-support, 32% mixed. The 16 unsupported seeds are candidate empirical instances of the zero-support unidentifiability result.
bak_100x8_rough_histogram.limitation: Collected under the old E0 tracing path, not under the new frozen protocol; comparison appendix only. The same 100 seeds are re-measured inside the new 240x8 run, which supersedes this sketch.

zero_support_tail_phase1.reading: Independent earlier probe (phase1 base probe) already found a 20-seed set where pi0 never succeeds. Together with the 16/100 unsupported seeds in the 100x8 sketch and the 73/200 zero-count census seeds, the zero-support tail is robustly non-empty on this task.

reference_only_not_in_method_chain.b1_n1_datasets: experiments/brace/datasets/place_*_{B1,N1}.jsonl - verified-fragment vs random-control chunk sets; violate the new w<=3 bound (historical w~99); cited only for the overuse discussion.
reference_only_not_in_method_chain.note: None of these artifacts are read by any T1+ script.

conclusions: Motivation established: within-state value variance is real but does not causally select useful training data (E0 v2 FAIL); the alternative is dose-response estimation of a capability-transport matrix over frozen difficulty groups.

p0(x) on the development task is strongly bimodal with a non-empty zero-support tail (16/100 at R=8; 73/200 at R=3; 20/20 in the phase1 probe), supporting both the coverage-collapse law and the zero-support unidentifiability target.

EXPLICIT: none of the legacy measurements defines frozen difficulty. The frozen difficulty definition still requires the new 240 seeds x R=8 pi0 baseline per development task under protocol.t1.v1.json (census R=3 and the 100x8 sketch remain comparison-appendix material only).
